items.title: Do some people still see Andrew Wiggins as a mild disappointment for a former #1 pick?
items.author: tdotshark
items.body_excerpt: Andrew Wiggins has had a weird career because his résumé is consistently solid, but it falls short of what people imagined in 2014 past the numbers. If he were drafted around 5-10, we’d probably talk about him as a successful pick. Being 1st, and having just one All-Star…
